rows.promptSnippet: Tell us about a challenge or adversity you’ve experienced and how that has impacted you as an individual.

evidenceSnippets: ess of how you apply, college credit may be considered for course placement. Early Decision Application Deadline: November 15, 2025 Regular Decision Application Deadline: January 5, 2026. If the $65 application fee poses a financial hardship, a fee waiver can be requested on the Common Application. Also note that there are no separate requirements for international students. Transfer Students with one year or more of full-time college coursework completed or in process should apply as transfers. Students with less than one year of full-time college coursework are encouraged to apply as first-years. Regardless of how you apply, college credit may be considered for course placement. While our standard transfer policy is stated above, we understand that your own experience might fall somewhere outside these parameters. For questions or guidance, please contact the Office of Admission by emailing admission@williams.edu. The transfer application deadline is March 2, 2026. Image icon View image gallery Additi
